title: Farmers and stone-raisers: the Neolithic and Carnac
story: Imagine a village in Brittany, around 4500 BC. The hunters of Lascaux are long gone. People now live in houses, keep sheep and cows, and grow wheat. Together they pull a huge stone upright and fix it in the earth. Nobody can write why. We can only wonder.
objective: I can explain what changed in the Neolithic and say what the stones of Carnac are.

write.heading: 1. A revolution
write.body: After the hunters of L2 (→ L2), the **Neolithic** ("new stone age") begins in France (still prehistory, → L1) around **6000 BC**. People learn **farming** and **herding**, make pottery and settle in villages. The idea comes from the Middle East and spreads along the Mediterranean.

write.heading: 2. Why it matters
write.body:
- Food can be stored, so the population grows.
- People stay in one place: villages, then a sense of property and power.
- Some people are free to build, make tools and trade.

write.heading: 3. The stones of Carnac
write.body: In Brittany, people raised more than **3,000 standing stones** in long lines, between about **4500 and 3300 BC**. A **menhir** is one standing stone. A **dolmen** is a stone table over a tomb. We do not know for sure why they were built: tombs, calendar or religion. Historians still debate it.

write.heading: 4. Draw
write.body: Rows of menhirs, and one dolmen (two stones with a flat stone on top).

check.q: What two big changes mark the Neolithic?
check.a: Farming and herding, which lead to settled villages.

check.q: What is the difference between a menhir and a dolmen?
check.a: A menhir is a single standing stone; a dolmen is a stone table over a tomb.

check.q: Why did food storage change society?
check.a: The population grew and people settled in villages.

read_more: Many menhirs have local legends. In Brittany, people say the lines at Carnac are Roman soldiers turned into stone by a wizard. The real builders lived over 4,000 years before Rome. The Carnac region was added to the UNESCO World Heritage list in 2025.
next: Next lesson: around 600 BC, Greek sailors found Marseille, and the Celts spread over the land.

links.why: Settled farmers replace the hunters of the caves.
Neolithic is still prehistory, before the Antiquity box.
